name: io.github.wonderpick/apify-b2b-ecom-automation-kit
title: Apify External Business Intelligence MCP Server
description: 14 external-intel tools & 12 prompts: Google News RAG, Substack, Shopify Apps, App Store, ATS & B2B.

tools.name: extract_brand_store_stockists
tools.description: Extract retail stockists carrying external brands and enrich each store domain with verified buyer emails and DNS deliverability checks. Supply at least one source (urls, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId); omitting all sources returns 0 items at $0. Optional filters (onlyIndependentStores, onlyWithEmail, minReadinessScore) gate billing before charge, while maxStoresPerBrand (1-5,000) bounds fan-out per brand. Bills $5/1K stores ($0 when empty or filtered), runs ~15-60s per brand with per-store failure isolation in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and optionally posts to webhookUrl. Use for wholesale retail prospecting; do not use for editing your own store map or enriching corporate B2B companies (use enrich_b2b_company_leads instead).

urls.description: Competitor brand homepages or store locator URLs, e.g. ["https://fellowproducts.com", "https://brooklynhotdogcompany.com"]. Optional when rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId is provided.

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV/TSV rows or newline-separated brand/locator URLs.

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID or URL containing brand or store locator URLs.

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId.

enrichEmails.description: Visit each unique retailer website (plus /wholesale and /contact) to extract buyer emails and social links.

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) to output deliverabilityGrade (A-F) and emailProvider.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only stores where at least one valid email is found ($0 otherwise).

onlyIndependentStores.description: When true, skip national chains (Target, Walmart, Sephora, Whole Foods, etc.) at $0 and return independent boutiques and regional shops.

maxStoresPerBrand.description: Maximum stockist locations to return per brand (1-5,000).

countryFilter.description: Optional country code or name filter, e.g. "US", "GB", "CA", "AU", "DE", or "KR".

minReadinessScore.description: Minimum outreachReadinessScore (0-100) required to save and bill ($0 for filtered stores).

crmExportPreset.description: Optional flat CRM column mapping preset while preserving standard fields.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL notified with run metrics and top stockists on completion.

tools.name: monitor_shopify_competitor_deltas
tools.description:
Monitor up to 50 external Shopify competitor stores (up to 2,500 products each) for price, stock, catalog, and MAP changes against persisted Key-Value Store snapshots.

Parameters: Requires storeUrls (omitting it returns 0 items at $0). minPriceChangePercent and mapThresholds trigger CRITICAL alerts, emitBaselineSummary controls first-run output, and stateStoreName isolates snapshots per workflow (avoid concurrent runs on the same stateStoreName). Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Writes persistent KV snapshots and optional webhookUrl alerts, isolates per-store or webhook errors in OUTPUT_SUMMARY without aborting, and bills $2/1K real deltas ($0 on baseline or unchanged runs).

Use for recurring Shopify SKU monitoring; do not use for editing your Shopify admin, Meta ad audits (use audit_meta_ads_advertisers), or retail stockists (use extract_brand_store_stockists).

storeUrls.description: List of 1 to 50 external Shopify store or collection URLs, e.g. ["https://www.allbirds.com"].

stateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store (alphanumeric and hyphens only) used to persist snapshots between runs.

maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum products to fetch per store URL (50-2,500, paginated at 250/page).

minPriceChangePercent.description: Minimum percentage change threshold (0-100) before emitting price_drop or price_increase.

eventTypes.description: Optional subset of catalog or pricing event types to emit.

mapThresholds.description: Optional map of SKU or product handle to Minimum Advertised Price (flags mapViolation: true and severity: CRITICAL if below threshold).

emitBaselineSummary.description: Emit 1 zero-cost baseline_initialized summary on the first snapshot of each store.

webhookUrl.description: Optional Slack, Discord, or n8n webhook URL notified when at least 1 delta occurs.

tools.name: audit_saas_trust_center
tools.description:
Audit or monitor external SaaS vendor Trust Centers (up to 500 domains) for security certifications, DNS IAM/SSO, and third-party or AI subprocessors.

Parameters: Requires domains (empty input returns 0 items at $0). mode="audit" runs statelessly, while mode="monitor" diffs against stateStoreName snapshots and uses emitBaselineSummary to control first-run rows; checkSubprocessors and checkDnsIam toggle deep checks, and concurrency bounds parallelism. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Persists monitor snapshots and optional webhookUrl alerts, isolates per-domain 403/timeout failures in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and bills $5/1K audited domains or real changes ($0 when unchanged or WAF-blocked).

Use for TPRM vendor risk or SOC 2 gap prospecting; do not use for editing internal GRC workspaces or local SMB website audits (use audit_local_b2b_websites instead).

domains.description: List of 1 to 500 external SaaS vendor or prospect domains, e.g. ["apify.com", "linear.app"].

mode.description: "audit" returns complete security posture immediately; "monitor" compares against snapshots and emits only real changes ($0 unchanged).

stateStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store used to persist baseline snapshots in monitor mode.

checkSubprocessors.description: Inspect /subprocessors pages and Trust Center content for third-party and AI vendors.

checkDnsIam.description: Query DNS CNAME/TXT/MX records to verify Trust Center hosting and SSO/IAM providers.

emitBaselineSummary.description: In monitor mode, emit 1 zero-cost baseline_initialized summary record per domain on its first run.

webhookUrl.description: Optional Slack, Discord, or n8n webhook URL notified in monitor mode when compliance or AI subprocessor changes occur.

tools.name: enrich_b2b_company_leads
tools.description: Resolve company names, domains, or work emails into verified official websites, LinkedIn company pages, business emails, and DNS deliverability grades. Supply at least one source (inputs, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId; omitting all returns 0 items at $0); datasetField selects the upstream column, minConfidence sets name-match strictness, and onlyWithEmail or includeUnresolved=false drops misses before billing. Streams in 50-item chunks (~10-45s per 100 companies) with per-company error isolation in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, optional webhookUrl delivery, and $2.50/1K enriched billing ($0 for parked, unresolved, or filtered skips). Use for B2B corporate enrichment; do not use for creator link-in-bio pages (use enrich_creator_bio_leads instead).

inputs.description: Up to 2,000 company names, domains, URLs, or work emails, e.g. ["Stripe", "Linear", "apify.com"]. Optional when rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId is provided.

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV/TSV rows or newline-separated company names, domains, URLs, or work emails.

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID or URL (auto-detects website, domain, companyName, name, or email fields).

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId.

datasetField.description: Optional explicit field name to read from datasetId/sourceRunId items when chaining.

enrichContactPages.description: Follow up to 2 internal /contact or /about pages when the homepage lacks emails or LinkedIn.

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) to output deliverabilityGrade (A-F) and emailProvider.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only companies where at least 1 verified email is found ($0 otherwise).

includeUnresolved.description: Include unresolved/not_found rows in the dataset for auditability (always $0 cost).

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for accepting company-name-to-domain matches.

crmExportPreset.description: Optional flat CRM column mapping preset while preserving standard fields.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL notified with run metrics and top leads on completion.

tools.name: enrich_creator_bio_leads
tools.description:
Enrich creator Link-in-Bio pages across 15+ bio platforms with verified agency or business emails, DNS deliverability checks, and sponsorship readiness scores.

Parameters: Supply at least one source (urls, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId; omitting all returns 0 items at $0). enableDeepContactFollow toggles 1-hop personal-site crawling, enableDnsEmailCheck runs DNS MX/SPF/DMARC checks, and onlyWithEmail or minReadinessScore filter before billing. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Email validity filters trap/placeholder domains and verifies DNS MX records; readiness scores (0-100) weight verified agency/direct emails, active brand-deal/monetization links, promo codes, and DNS grade. Streams up to 50,000 profiles at $2.50/1K enriched ($0 on 404, WAF, or filtered skips), isolating per-profile failures in OUTPUT_SUMMARY with optional webhookUrl delivery.

Use for influencer and UGC sponsorship outreach; do not use for corporate B2B companies (use enrich_b2b_company_leads instead).

urls.description: List of creator Link-in-Bio URLs or handles, e.g. ["https://linktr.ee/heathertraska", "https://stan.store/stan"]. Optional when rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId is provided.

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV/TSV rows or newline-separated creator Link-in-Bio URLs.

datasetId.description: Optional Apify Dataset ID or URL from an upstream Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube scraper (preserves upstreamHandle and upstreamFollowers).

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId.

enableDeepContactFollow.description: When no email is on the bio page, follow up to 2 personal website, Contact, or Media Kit links (1-hop, SSRF-safe, Cloudflare decoding included).

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) on custom creator/agency email domains.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only creators with at least 1 valid email ($0 when missing).

minReadinessScore.description: Minimum Creator Brand-Deal Readiness Score (0-100) required to save and bill.

maxProfiles.description: Maximum unique creator bio URLs to process (1-50,000).

maxConcurrency.description: Concurrent requests (1-20; capped automatically on 128-256 MB containers).

crmExportPreset.description: Optional flat CRM column mapping preset while preserving standard fields.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL notified with run metrics and top creators on completion.

tools.name: search_korea_mfds_recalls
tools.description: Search official South Korea MFDS cosmetic recall and sales-suspension orders in English or Korean. Filter inputs accept English or Korean terms (50+ K-Beauty terms like "sunscreen", "soap", and "Cosmax" auto-translate server-side); omitting all filters returns recent orders up to maxItems (default 100), and onlyActiveRecalls excludes lifted orders before billing. Queries the live MFDS public API (~2-10s) with automatic retries on transient gateway errors and bills $3/1K matches ($0 if none). Use for K-Beauty import safety and recall screening; do not use for US FDA/EU recalls or functional OEM factory discovery (use search_korea_mfds_oem_filings instead).

companyName.description: Optional brand or manufacturer filter in English or Korean, e.g. "Cosmax", "Cowell", or "코스맥스".

productName.description: Optional product keyword in English or Korean, e.g. "sunscreen", "soap", "lip balm", or "선크림".

onlyActiveRecalls.description: When true, return and bill only currently active recall orders (hiding expired notices at $0).

businessNumber.description: Optional Korean 10-digit business registration number (hyphens ignored), e.g. "2158733119".

recallOrderDateFrom.description: Optional start date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2025-01-01".

recallOrderDateTo.description: Optional end date filter in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-12-31".

tools.name: search_korea_mfds_oem_filings
tools.description:
Search 219,000+ official South Korea MFDS functional cosmetic filings in English or Korean to uncover Korean OEM/ODM factories and functional claims.

Parameters: Filter inputs accept English or Korean (common terms like "sunscreen", "Cosmax", "Kolmar" auto-bridge; unmapped English falls back to raw substring match). datasetType selects reported, reviewed, or both registries, resolveOemFromReviewed joins reviewed base formulas to expose hidden factories, and maxItems caps scan volume. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Queries the live MFDS API (~5-20s; slower when resolveOemFromReviewed joins formulas) with transient retries and bills $2/1K records ($0 if empty).

Use for K-Beauty OEM sourcing and R&D; do not use for recall checks (use search_korea_mfds_recalls instead).

datasetType.description: Which MFDS registry to query: "reported" (198k+ brand filings), "reviewed" (20k+ OEM base formulas), or "both".

productName.description: Product keyword in English or Korean (e.g. "sunscreen", "retinol cream", "serum", "선크림") — English auto-translates server-side.

brandOrDistributor.description: Brand or responsible seller in English or Korean, e.g. "Amorepacific", "Olive Young", "Medicube", or "아모레퍼시픽".

oemManufacturer.description: OEM/ODM factory in English or Korean, e.g. "Cosmax", "Kolmar", "Cosmecca", or "코스맥스".

efficacyKeyword.description: Efficacy claim filter in English or Korean: "whitening", "anti-wrinkle", "uv-protection", "SPF", "hair-loss", "미백", "주름".

itemCode.description: Exact MFDS ITEM_SEQ or COSMETIC_REPORT_SEQ identifier for single-product lookup.

resolveOemFromReviewed.description: Query linked reviewed base formulas automatically to reveal hidden OEM/ODM factories when missing on reported filings.

tools.name: audit_local_b2b_websites
tools.description:
Audit local SMB websites for technical, SEO, pixel, and DNS deliverability weaknesses, then extract owner emails and factual cold-pitch copy.

Parameters: Supply at least one source (websiteUrls, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId + datasetField, sourceRunId, or presetChambers; omitting all returns 0 items at $0). agencyPreset tailors scoring and copy, dedupStoreName + dedupMode persist 16-shard KV snapshots for skip_seen or watch_diff modes, and onlyWithEmail, onlyWithWeakness, or minPitchScore filter before billing. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Writes KV dedup shards and optional webhookUrl payloads, isolates per-site WAF/timeout errors in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and bills $4.50/1K leads ($0 on WAF, filtered misses, or skip_seen repeats).

Use for local agency prospecting; do not use for SaaS SOC 2 audits (use audit_saas_trust_center) or Meta/DTC ad audits (use audit_meta_ads_advertisers).

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or Console URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId and streams leads.

enableContactPageFollow.description: Follow up to 1 internal /contact, /about, or /team page when the homepage lacks an email.

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) to output deliverabilityGrade (A-F) and emailProvider.

onlyWithWeakness.description: When true, skip polished websites with 0 detected weaknesses at $0.

minPitchScore.description: Minimum 0-100 pitchPriorityScore required to save and bill ($0 below threshold).

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) to output deliverabilityGrade (A-F) and emailProvider.

tools.name: monitor_ats_hiring_intent

Monitor live ATS job openings, hard-to-fill role aging, and tech-stack hiring intent across 13 ATS engines and 7 global job feeds.

Parameters: Supply targets, presetPacks, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId—or leave targets empty with titleKeywords or techStackFilter to trigger global discovery (omitting both targets and filters returns 0 items at $0). outputMode selects jobs, companies, or both; onlyHardToFillSweetSpot and onlyNewSinceLastRun filter before billing, while dedupStoreName + dedupMode track weekly changes. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Behavior & Billing: Writes optional KV snapshots and webhookUrl alerts, runs ~5-30s isolating per-board errors in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and bills $0.99/1K saved rows ($0 on filtered or unchanged skips).

Pre-charge filters (minOpportunityScore, painBucketFilter, switchIntentOnly, onlyWithEmail) and watchDiff + dedupStoreName gate billing. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Billing: $5/1K unified apps or $0.50/1K streamed reviews ($0 on filtered or unchanged skips); isolates per-app errors in OUTPUT_SUMMARY and supports webhookUrl. Use for mobile churn/ASO audits; do not use for Shopify apps (audit_shopify_app_churn_leads).

androidPackageIds.description: Google Play package IDs (e.g. ["com.duolingo"]) or play.google.com URLs; auto-matched to iOS including cross-script pairs.

upstreamItems.description: Optional structured pipeline items ({ iosAppId, androidPackageId, appUrl, domain, companyName, label }) for zero-permission n8n/Clay/MCP chaining.

tools.name: audit_shopify_app_churn_leads

starFilter.description: Review star filter (defaults to "critical_1_2" in merchant_churn_leads mode and "all" in app_intelligence mode).

includeDevWebsiteEnrich.description: Enrich developer support email, official website URL, and DNS MX/SPF/DMARC deliverability.

generateDashboardHtml.description: Save a self-contained interactive executive HTML dashboard to OUTPUT_DASHBOARD.html in the Key-Value Store.

watchDiff.description: Compare against prior KV snapshots to flag pricing, Built for Shopify, rating, and new critical review changes ($0 when unchanged).

dedupStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store used to persist snapshots when watchDiff is enabled.

onlyWithEmail.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps where a developer email is verified ($0 otherwise).

onlyBuiltForShopify.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps carrying the Built for Shopify badge ($0 otherwise).

onlyVeteranChurn.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps or merchant leads showing veteran-store churn (>=180 days usage, $0 otherwise).

switchIntentOnly.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps or merchant leads mentioning switching to a named competitor ($0 otherwise).

minChurnRiskScore.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only apps with churnRiskScore >= threshold ($0 below).

crmPreset.description: Optional flat OWASP CSV-safe CRM export preset.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL to receive high-churn or watchDiff alerts.

tools.name: audit_substack_newsletters_leads
tools.description:
Audit Substack newsletters across 35 categories, search queries, or handles/URLs for Stripe USD paid ARR floors, sponsor brands, MX/DMARC author emails, RAG post archives, and Notes/comments.

Parameters: Supply categories, searchQueries, publicationUrlsOrHandles, or upstreamItems (empty returns 0 items at $0). Mode params: newsletter_intelligence uses discoveryBoard/includeAboutAndDomainEnrich/outreachPersona/watchDiff/pre-charge filters; post_sponsor_stream uses maxPostsPerPublication/includeCleanPostText; notes_and_comments uses maxNotesPerAuthor/maxCommentsPerPost. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Billing: 128 MB pure HTTP ($0 proxy); $4/1K newsletters, $0.40/1K posts, or $0.25/1K notes/comments ($0 on empty/unchanged/filtered misses); optional webhookUrl. Use for Substack sponsor leads, revenue intel & RAG; do not use for news monitoring (monitor_google_news_rag_triggers).

mode.description: Execution mode: newsletter_intelligence ($4/1K dossiers), post_sponsor_stream ($0.40/1K RAG posts + sponsors), or notes_and_comments ($0.25/1K public Notes + nested comments).

categories.description: Optional Substack category slugs or names (e.g. ["technology", "finance", "business", "culture"]). Optional when searchQueries or publicationUrlsOrHandles is provided.

discoveryBoard.description: Substack category board to pull: paid (bestsellers), trending (rising), public_all (free + paid), or both_leaderboards.

searchQueries.description: Optional Substack search keywords to discover niche newsletters (e.g. ["semiconductors", "ai engineering"]).

publicationUrlsOrHandles.description: Optional direct Substack URLs, custom newsletter domains, subdomains, or @author handles (e.g. ["https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com", "bytebytego", "@semianalysis"]).

upstreamItems.description: Optional upstream JSON rows from Clay, Make, n8n, or another Apify Actor for cross-run chaining under LIMITED_PERMISSIONS.

maxPostsPerPublication.description: Maximum recent posts per publication via streaming RSS or /api/v1/archive cursor pagination (1-500).

includeCleanPostText.description: In post_sponsor_stream mode, fetch full public post bodies and output paragraph-preserving cleanPlainText + ragTokenEstimate.

maxNotesPerAuthor.description: In notes_and_comments mode, maximum public Substack Notes per author (0-200).

maxCommentsPerPost.description: In notes_and_comments mode, maximum flattened nested reader comments per post (0-200).

includeAboutAndDomainEnrich.description: Fetch /about, author public_profile, and 1-hop custom domain /sponsor or /contact pages for emails, media kits, and DNS MX/SPF/DMARC checks.

outreachPersona.description: Outreach persona used to tailor outreachSubject and outreachBody.

onlyWithEmail.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only newsletters with at least one verified email ($0 otherwise).

onlyWithSponsorSignal.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only newsletters with detected sponsor blocks, banners, or media-kit links ($0 otherwise).

excludeDormant.description: Pre-charge filter: skip dormant newsletters with no post in 45+ days at $0.

minBestsellerTier.description: Pre-charge filter: minimum Substack bestseller paid-subscriber badge tier (0, 100, 1000, 10000; $0 below).

watchDiff.description: Enable weekly stateful watch_diff in newsletter_intelligence mode to skip unchanged publications at $0 and emit 8 change triggers.

dedupStoreName.description: Optional Apify Named Key-Value Store name for watchDiff snapshots (default: substack-intel-watch).

crmPreset.description: Optional flat OWASP CSV-safe CRM export preset.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL to receive run results.

tools.name: monitor_google_news_rag_triggers
tools.description:
Scrape Google News across EN/KO/JA/DE/ES with 5-in-1 publisher URL decoding (Bing News fallback), streaming HTML full-text & 512-token RAG chunks, 3-layer paywall sibling rescue, 10 B2B/PR event triggers, cross-lingual clustering, and $0-skip watchDiff monitoring.

Parameters: Supply queries, topics, or topicOrClusterUrls (defaults to NVIDIA AI). Mode params: news_headlines_intel uses decodeUrls/onlyWithTriggers; full_article_rag adds streaming full text, paywall rescue, onlyFullText, and ragChunkMaxTokens. Supports locales, timeframe, dedupeSimilarStories, watchDiff + dedupStoreName, and webhookUrl. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Billing: 128 MB pure HTTP ($0 proxy); $0.80/1K headlines or $1.50/1K full-text RAG articles (up to 50% off; $0 on watchDiff skips/filtered misses). Use for live news RAG, PR crisis & B2B trigger tracking; do not use for Substack newsletters (audit_substack_newsletters_leads).

mode.description: news_headlines_intel ($0.80/1K: decoded URLs + 10 B2B/PR triggers + clusters) or full_article_rag ($1.50/1K: adds streaming full text, 3-layer paywall sibling rescue & 512-token RAG chunks).

queries.description: Search keywords or boolean queries (e.g. ["OpenAI", "NVIDIA AI", "cyberattack healthcare"]).

topicOrClusterUrls.description: Optional direct Google News topic, search, or RSS feed URLs.

locales.description: COUNTRY:lang locales for cross-lingual monitoring and clustering (e.g. ["US:en", "KR:ko", "JP:ja", "DE:de", "ES:es"]).

timeframe.description: Recency window applied to search queries (e.g. "24h" for daily cron, "7d" for weekly briefs).

maxArticles.description: Maximum deduplicated stories to process per run (1-2,000).

decodeUrls.description: Decode obfuscated news.google.com redirect links into real publisher URLs in 5-in-1 pure HTTP batches.

dedupeSimilarStories.description: Emit 1 canonical representative per cross-lingual story cluster with coverageCount and relatedSources.

onlyFullText.description: In full_article_rag mode, skip blocked/paywalled rows without full text or sibling rescue at $0.

onlyWithTriggers.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only stories matching at least one of the 10 B2B/PR event triggers ($0 otherwise).

ragChunkMaxTokens.description: In full_article_rag mode, target token size for overlap-preserving ragChunks (128-2,048).

watchDiff.description: Skip previously seen articles BEFORE URL decoding at $0 using immutable run-delta KV snapshots.

dedupStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store for watchDiff 90-day rolling LRU snapshots.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL to receive run summary and breaking triggers.
